candidate_sentences.text: Financial strength improved.
Cash increased to EUR 219.8 million from EUR 167.6 million, and operating cash flow rose to EUR 384.0 million from EUR 89.3 million.
Interest-bearing liabilities declined to EUR 1.071 billion from EUR 1.223 billion, while net debt fell to EUR 851.6 million from EUR 1.056 billion; net debt to EBITDA improved to 3.7 from 4.0.
Total equity increased to EUR 1.175 billion and the equity ratio improved to 45% from 43%.
Infortar paid approximately EUR 62 million in dividends for 2024 and proposed a 2025 dividend of EUR 3.02 per share.
